description: Scrape Snapchat Spotlight videos by hashtag. Extract video metadata, engagement stats, creator info, and download URLs from public Snapchat pages.

hashtags.description: Hashtags, topic names, or topic URLs. Examples: food, #travel, humor, https://www.snapchat.com/topic/humor
hashtags.title: Hashtags / Topics

includeLlmMetadata.description: Include LLM-generated title, description, and keywords
includeLlmMetadata.title: Include AI Metadata

includeRelatedTopics.description: Include related topics/tags in each result record
includeRelatedTopics.title: Include Related Topics

includeVideoUrls.description: Include direct video download URLs in output. Note: video URLs contain expiring tokens and may stop working after some time.
includeVideoUrls.title: Include Video URLs

resultsPerHashtag.description: Maximum number of videos to extract per hashtag. Snapchat returns up to 32 SSR results per page.
resultsPerHashtag.title: Results Per Hashtag

title: Snapchat Hashtag Scraper Input
